title: Time of Reckoning

text.content: "Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the Five Elders' secret stronghold. The overcast sky pressed down extremely low, as if even the heavens were raging for the coming reckoning. Chen Ji stood atop the mountain summit, behind him hundreds of inner disciples in formation, swords gleaming coldly in their hands. Han Lie stood at his side, his black battle armor reflecting cold light beneath the dark clouds, his eyes filled with long-suppressed battle intent. 'Is everything ready?' Chen Ji spoke calmly, his voice unruffled as if he were not about to carry out a blood-soaked purge. From the distant stronghold came turmoil—the Five Elders' remnants seemed to have sensed their impending doom. '(Protagonist's sense of flawless planning, building爽文 momentum)'

"The stronghold's gate exploded with a thunderous roar, and amid the swirling dust, five elderly figures stepped through the air. The leader, white-haired and white-bearded, had eyes like lightning, and a surge of spiritual pressure emanated from him—this was the chief of the Five Elders, Zhao Wuji, a Nascent Soul realm powerhouse. 'Chen Ji!' Zhao Wuji roared in fury, 'Youtrashdare to lead an assault against us? Do you think the Five Elders have no one?' Chen Ji's lips curved slightly as he calmly produced the Tianji Record Fragment. 'Elder Zhao, when you Five Elders joined forces to frame my father back then, did any of you imagine this day would come?' (Villain depiction: showing his arrogance and confidence, but should set up for being crushed)'

The celestial phenomena across the heavens were precisely Heaven avenging my father.' He raised his hand gently, and the hundreds of disciples behind him cried out in unison, their voices echoing through the valley. 'Today—what else could this be but a reckoning?'

text.content: "Zhao Wuji's expression shifted slightly, then he grinned savagely: 'Good! Good a clever-tongued little beast! You think this handful of men can touch the Five Elders?' He abruptly crushed the jade talisman in his hand, and from the distant valley came a thunderous rumble. The next moment, waves of black mist surged from all directions, and thousands of black-robed demonic cultivators surged forth like a tide! 'Surprised?' Zhao Wuji cackled wildly, 'This is the Five Elders' true trump card! Three hundred thousand demonic soldiers, secretly infiltrated with the help of our Holy Sect allies!' (Revealing the true trump card, escalating the conflict)'

dialogue.content: "The demonic army?' Chen Ji's brow rose slightly, yet there was not a trace of panic in his expression—instead, a knowing smile appeared. 'Elder Zhao, do you truly believe Ling Yuan would risk the entire Tianqing Sect for a bunch of oldtrash?' He flicked his hand, and a jade slip sliced through the air, landing before the demonic army. 'Fellow demonic cultivators, do you still remember what the Holy Sect promised you?' The jade slip shattered, and countless images materialized in the sky—the secret agreement between Holy Sect elders and demonic leaders, along with that刺眼的 promise: 'After the matter is settled, dispose of the discarded pieces.' (Protagonist's counter-move: intelligence already in hand)'

text.content: "The demonic army's formation faltered instantly, and heated discussions erupted everywhere. Chen Ji pressed the advantage, his clear voice ringing across the entire field: 'You traveled thousands of miles—do you truly wish to become the Holy Sect's discarded pieces? My Tianqing Sect opens its gates wide. Those who depart now shall be forgiven without question, and shall receive compensation in cultivation resources.' At these words, the demonic cultivators exchanged glances, and moments later, thousands retreated like a receding tide, leaving the flabbergasted Five Elders' remnants. '(爽文 rhythm: the enemy's trump card becomes a joke)'

dialogue.content: "Clever scheming.' A cold voice drifted from the void, and Ling Yuan's figure slowly materialized, his black robe billowing, murder evident in his eyes. 'But do you think this is the end?' He abruptly sacrificed a pitch-black令牌, and the world between heaven and earth suddenly darkened. 'Holy Sect secret technique—Ten Thousand Souls Devour Heaven!' Countless vengeful spirits poured from the令牌, forming a churning black tide that swept toward Chen Ji.

text.content: "Chen Ji's brow center twitched, yet he did not dodge—instead, he stepped forward to meet the black tide. 'Ling Yuan, did you truly think I wouldn't know you were coming?' He pressed two fingers together, lightly touching his brow center. The Tianji Record Fragment erupted in dazzling golden light. 'Three days ago, I already foresaw this moment—you would expose all your trump cards in despair.' Golden light collided violently with the black tide, and Ling Yuan's secret technique was forcibly suppressed! '(Protagonist displays flawless planning, Tianji Record ability showcase)'

dialogue.content: "At this moment, Han Lie stomped forward fiercely, his black battle armor erupting in dazzling radiance. 'Ling Yuan! Three years ago you schemed to frame my Xuanwu Sect disciples—today we settle both old and new debts!' He punched out, the拳风 howling with surging fury. Ling Yuansneeredwaved his sleeve to block, but was sent tumbling backward several steps. 'Han Lie? Do you think a莽夫 like you is qualified—' Before he could finish, Chen Ji had already appeared behind him like a specter.

text.content: "Chen Ji seized Ling Yuan by the back of his neck with one hand, his movements effortless, as if merely grabbing a lamb for slaughter. 'Ling Yuan, your greatest mistake wasn't opposing me—it was underestimating the speed of my arrangements.' His voice was calm, yet it made Ling Yuan's whole body go cold. 'You think my father's death three years ago was an accident? You think all these years of scheming went unnoticed?' Chen Ji produced a recording stone from his chest—the images clearly showed Ling Yuan meeting in secret with Holy Sect elders! '(Key revelation: ironclad evidence of Ling Yuan's collusion with the demonic path)'

This man is the chief culprit who colluded with the demonic path and murdered my father! Today, before the ancestors, family law shall be executed!' Ling Yuan struggled desperately, yet an invisible force bound him. Hundreds of disciples witnessed this historic moment, all horrified.'

dialogue.content: "'I, Chen Ji, do not seek revenge today—I seek to purify the Tianqing Sect!' He slashed his hand down violently, and a sword qi pierced through Ling Yuan's dantian, destroying his lifetime of cultivation. Ling Yuan let out a凄厉 scream, his former dignity utterly gone.'

A stunning figure arrived through the air, demonic energy churning around her, yet without hostile intent—it was Ye Qing. Behind her followed hundreds of demonic elite soldiers, all in black劲装, their banners embroidered with the bizarre Holy Sect emblem. 'Chen Ji, you've waited long.' dialogue.content: "Chen Ji received the jade slips, his神识 scanning them, his eyes gleaming. 'Good, very good.' He looked at Ling Yuan collapsed on the ground, a cold smile curling his lips. 'Ling Yuan, do you have anything else to say?' Ling Yuan trembled all over, yet suddenly burst into mad laughter, the laughter growing louder, more凄厉, until it resounded through the entire valley. 'Chen Ji... do you think you've won?' He abruptly raised his head, eyes full of madness and mockery, 'Your father's death—there was someone else!'

text.content: "Chen Ji frowned, crouching down to stare directly at Ling Yuan: 'Speak clearly.' Ling Yuan grinned coldly, blood dripping from the corner of his mouth as if he felt nothing: 'You think I hated your father? I was merely a chess piece... The one who truly wanted him dead... is someone you could never have imagined...' He abruptly crushed a forbidden technique jade talisman hidden under his tongue, and his spiritual pressure surged violently! 'Unfortunately I cannot say, but you will learn—' He lunged at Chen Ji with mad laughter.'

text.content: "Chen Ji appeared to move to block, yet at the last moment subtly angled his body, causing Ling Yuan's self-detonation direction to veer toward where the Five Elders' remnant forces had gathered. 'BOOM!' Three of the Five Elders were instantly turned to ash, and Zhao Wuji collapsed to the ground, severely wounded. Everyone saw Chen Ji 'regretfully' sigh: 'Alas, what a pity—I had intended to send them off personally.'

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing watched clearly from afar, a meaningful smile curling her lips. Han Lie, meanwhile, slapped Chen Ji's shoulder boisterously: 'Brother Chen, you're ruthless enough. I like it!'

text.content: "Ling Yuan's fall marks the end of an era. The Five Elders' remnant forces were thoroughly purged today, and the Tianqing Sect welcomed long-awaited peace. Yet Chen Ji stood atop the mountain summit, gazing toward where Ling Yuan's remains lay, a lingering gloom between his brows. 'Someone else...' he murmured to himself. 'Ling Yuan, what were you trying to say?' The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace grew faintly warm, as if reminding him—the chess game of destiny is far from over. Far away in the Holy Sect's main hall, thousands of miles distant, that awakening consciousness slowly opened its eyes.'
